build_BaseModel: build a BaseModel instance from an OmegaConf config with backbone, temporal aggregator, and classifier components
run_forward_singlecrop: run forward_singlecrop on a video tensor to extract backbone features, temporal aggregates, and future predictions
run_forward_multicrop: run forward on a multi-crop video tensor to get averaged features and auxiliary losses across crops
review_apply_classifier: review the _apply_classifier method that applies classifiers or class mappings to generate logits for each class type
refactor_initialize_weights: refactor the _initialize_weights method to customize Kaiming normal init for Conv3d and Linear layers
